values.title: Typed realtime queries
values.body:
Subscribe to any query and get updates that keep the full type of the result. The client infers the row shape from your schema, so a subscription is as safe to use as a one-off read.

## Live queries

- `db.tasks.subscribe()` returns a typed async iterator of rows.

- Updates are diffed on the server, so only changed rows are sent.

- Row-level rules run on every update, not just the first result.

## Upgrading

Existing `watch()` calls keep working. Switch to `subscribe()` when you want inferred types and automatic reconnects.
